dev_decision.chunk: A has the strongest DEV Hit@5 and MRR, with the fewest chunks and smallest index.
dev_decision.retriever: BM25 and Hybrid BM25-weight 0.75 tie on DEV Hit@1 and Hit@5. Hybrid's MRR gain is 0.0175, while its P95 rises from about 1.4 to 22 ms and requires a 471 MB model and 169 s passage indexing. Neural Dense alone is lower on the main quality metrics.
dev_decision.top_k: Top-3 retrieves 15/22 DEV answerable questions; Top-5 and Top-8 both retrieve 18/22, and neither retrieves both required cross-document sources. Keep five candidates to avoid extra context and candidate noise.
dev_decision.document_diversity: The single cap-2 DEV trial lowers Hit@5 from 0.8182 to 0.7273 without recovering both cross-document sources; keep uncapped.
